preserved_corrections.finding: legacy active outbox rows from schema v1 through v3 could lack the new stable logical and provider identity fields and fail the v4 sending-claim guard
preserved_corrections.correction: deterministically backfill every non-confirmed legacy row before claim and add an existing-v1 upgrade regression

preserved_corrections.finding: the inherited unsupported locale stopped the first post-build checksum command
preserved_corrections.correction: rerun the unchanged four-file artifact checksum and manifest gates under the C locale

preserved_corrections.finding: the first look-around parser was unsupported, a PCRE locale attempt stopped locally, a known-host comment was initially counted as a key record and one combined preflight command stopped without a usable diagnostic
preserved_corrections.correction: use the portable bounded-address parser, exact pseudonymous target hash, non-comment three-key known-host gate and split key-only identity plus zero-safe read-only preflight

preserved_corrections.finding: direct SFTP could not traverse the root-protected incoming parent; a later ordinary-user checksum tried to enter the now root-only exact directory
preserved_corrections.correction: checksum four files in an owner-only transient upload directory, install each exact file with sudo, clean the upload directory and perform the protected-directory checksum with sudo

preserved_corrections.finding: the first cleanup precondition used ordinary-user file tests against root-controlled candidate and staging directories and stopped before deletion
preserved_corrections.correction: prove every exact protected path with sudo test, lock the acceptance report hash, then remove only the named staging, env, incoming and synthetic runtime paths

preserved_corrections.finding: the first read-only release-list command requested an unsupported JSON field and returned no usable count
preserved_corrections.correction: use the supported release tag field together with exact remote branch, ref, tag and PR checks
